prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership of results with an option to assign, which gives the company a clear path to full owner

content.text:
The researcher moved from their likely position to uni_owns_option_to_assign and 30-day review. I proposed company_owns_uni_academic_use and 60-day review. 

uni_owns_option_to_assign gives us a path to ownership, which is workable. The 30-day review is a concern given our confidential client traffic data, but 60 days is our preference. Let me accept the IP compromise but push back on review days to 60, as we have confidential client data in publications.

I can change at most two fields. I'll keep uni_owns_option_to_assign (accept their IP position) and push reviewDays back to 60.
